relationships.subject: EP4R
relationships.evidence_quote: The reversal of the hypersensitivity at the highest dose suggests that activation of EP4R is a major contributor to the PGE2-induced hypersensitivity.

key_findings: Docking of >400M compounds yielded a selective 16 nM EP4R antagonist (compound 74) with oral bioavailability and anti-allodynic and anti-inflammatory activity in mouse carrageenan, CFA and PGE2 models.
Compound 74 does not inhibit COX-1/2 and is peripherally restricted.
